answer: Reaching the opal of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the prism until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the juniper of the next round. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
